title: Vegetarian Tonkotsu-style Ramen
description: A vegetarian Ramen with Tonkotsu-style broth. Makes 4-5 servings; you can make fewer and save the remaining broth for another time.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.note: For the broth. Fresh minced, or ginger paste.

ingredients.name: Peanut oil
ingredients.note: For the broth. Any vegetable cooking oil works as a substitute.

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock cubes
ingredients.note: For the broth. Enough for 2 litres of stock per packaging instructions. Consider low-salt cubes to reduce risk of making the broth too salty.

ingredients.name: Almond milk
ingredients.note: For the broth. Any plant-based milk without a strong flavour.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (japanese, e.g. Kikkoman)
ingredients.note: For the broth. Chinese soy sauce has a stronger flavour and will affect the broth.

ingredients.name: Selection of mushrooms
ingredients.note: Shiitake, wood ear, enoki — try a variety of sizes and types.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.note: Must be at room temperature. Optionally use marinated Ajitsuke Tamago eggs instead.

stages.label: Preparation - Broth
stages.description: Prepare all the broth ingredients before cooking.

steps.instruction: Ensure eggs for the later ramen step are out of the fridge and at room temperature.
Mince the {1} of garlic.
Halve the onion. Store or discard the other half. Dice the half you're using.
Peel and mince {1} of ginger.
steps.hint: You can substitute ginger paste if preferred.

steps.instruction: Prepare {1} of vegetable stock by mixing water with the appropriate number of stock cubes per packaging instructions.
Measure out {1} of cashews.
Measure out {1} of kombu.

stages.label: Cooking - Broth
stages.description: Cook the broth base, then blend in the cashew and mushroom mixture.

steps.instruction: Place the dried shiitake mushroom in {1} of hot (not boiling) water to rehydrate.
Place the cashews in {1} of hot (not boiling) water to rehydrate.
Heat {1} peanut oil in the large saucepan/pot over medium-high heat.
Once oil is hot, add the diced onions. Stir infrequently.
Add the garlic and ginger. Continue stirring infrequently.
Add the {1} vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Add the kombu.
Take off heat. Strain out the onions, garlic, ginger, and kombu.
Stir in the blended cashew/mushroom mix. It should be thick enough to coat a spoon. If too thick, add some of the saved soaking water. Add {1} salt, or to taste.
Measure out {1} nutritional yeast flakes.
Measure out {1} almond milk.
Remove the shiitake mushroom and cashews from their soaking water. Save the soaking water for later.
Blend the nutritional yeast, {1} sesame oil, {2} soy sauce, the mushroom, cashews, and almond milk on a low setting for 20 seconds.
steps.hint: If the consistency is too thick to blend, add some of the soaking water. The ideal texture should be quite thick but uniform.

steps.instruction: Blend for a further 30 seconds until smooth.

stages.label: Preparation - Ramen
stages.description: Prepare the ramen toppings and vegetables.

steps.instruction: Trim and slice the courgette.
Slice your selection of mushrooms into roughly similar sizes. Small mushrooms can be cooked whole.
steps.hint: For enoki mushrooms, trim the roots, pull apart slightly with your hands — they'll separate further as they cook.

steps.instruction: Trim the bok choy and slice into halves or large pieces.
Measure out as much marinated tofu as you'd like.
Trim the ends, branches, and outer layer of the {1}. Slice the remainder, keeping the white and green parts separate.

stages.label: Cooking - Ramen
stages.description: Stir-fry the vegetables, cook the noodles, and assemble the bowls.

steps.instruction: Add a drizzle of oil to your frying pan over medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the white spring onion and mushrooms (except enoki). Stir regularly.
Add the courgette, tofu, and bok choy. Boil a kettle for the noodles.
Add the enoki mushrooms, if using.
Add the green spring onion.
Remove from heat.
Put heat under the broth again. Ensure it is boiling hot before serving.
Using the normal saucepan and the boiled water, cook the noodles per packet instructions.
Slice each egg in half vertically.
Serve the noodles, fried vegetables, and eggs between bowls along with a handful of spinach, then ladle as much boiling hot broth as you'd like into each bowl and top with nori.
